name: logoshome-native
description: Capacitor shell wrapping the LogosHome web build for Android / iOS

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync && npm run patch:android
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync android && npm run patch:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:web && npx cap sync ios
